 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Arvind Singh Chandel

ORAL ORDER 3 13-08-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the respondents.
2. This revision petition has been preferred by the applicants being aggrieved with the order/judgment dated 07.03.2024 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-V, Barh,
District-Patna in Cr. Appeal No. 54 of 2022, whereby the learned Appellate Court affirmed the order/judgment of conviction of the applicants for the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Patna High Court CR. REV. No.410 of 2024(3)
dt.13-08-2024 Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that petitioner no.1, who is the husband of opposite party no. 2, arrested on 04.07.2024 and petitioner nos. 2 and 3, who are the father-in-law and mother-in-law of opposite party no. 2 respectively have surrendered on 06.07.2024 and since then they are in custody.
He submits that both petitioner nos. 2 and 3 are aged persons and in custody since 06.07.2024.

He further submits that the records of the Court below has not been Chandan Kumar @ Chandan Chouhan vs The State Of Bihar on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2085543/

sentences.text: Thus, it is prayed by learned counsel that both applicant nos. 2 and 3 may be granted benefit of bail.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Opposite Party no. 2 does not oppose the prayer made by the learned counsel for the petitioners.
5. Having considered the above facts and circumstances of the case as well as the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners, the prayer of the petitioners is allowed.

Let the above named petitioner nos. 2 and 3 be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Additional District and Sessions Judge-V, Barh, Patna High Court CR.
